tools.name: search_incentives
tools.description: Search Italian public grants, incentives and calls (national catalogue incentivi.gov.it plus regional and chamber-of-commerce calls), refreshed nightly. Open calls only by default. Text in Italian.

tools.name: get_incentive
tools.description: Full card of one incentive: requirements, beneficiaries, eligible costs, amounts, deadline, official link and the source summary.

tools.name: match_business
tools.description: Ranks the open calls for a business profile and explains each score in plain Italian. No model call: a transparent database score.

tools.name: closing_soon
tools.description: Open calls closing within N days (default 30), soonest first.

tools.name: catalogue_stats
tools.description: Live numbers: open calls, calls closing in 30 days, grants, total budget, remote jobs, places, and per-region counts.

tools.name: search_remote_jobs
tools.description: Remote jobs workable from Italy (Jobicy, Remotive, Himalayas; credit and apply link kept). Filter by text or skill area.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Italian municipalities (all 7,900) with population, coordinates and any programme that pays people to move there (1-euro houses, residence bonuses).

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: One municipality: population, province, coordinates, programmes for new residents, and the regional incentives open to people.

tools.name: relocation_programmes
tools.description: Verified programmes that pay or help people to move: 1-euro houses, residence bonuses, subsidised homes, remote-worker schemes. Each with its official source.

tools.name: plan_preview
tools.description: Free preview of the secondlife.it personal plan: how many places, remote jobs and incentives fit a person, with the top few of each. No model call.

tools.name: catalogue_trends
tools.description: Time series of the Italian incentives catalogue since 2021: calls opened per month, calls open at mid-month, calls closing per month, seasonality (which months are busy), a 6-month estimate with range, and which purposes are growing. Optional region.

tools.name: expected_calls
tools.description: Calls that recur every year (same body, same call, opened in at least two years): past openings, usual month and the expected next opening date, with a confidence level. Use it to tell a user when a closed call should reopen.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Paid services an agent can order for its user (eligibility check, application draft, personal plan, municipality dossier, remote-job kit) and subscriptions.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Orders a paid report. With an API key that has credit, it is paid at once and generated; otherwise it returns a checkout_url to hand to the human (Stripe), who pays and receives the report by email. Input depends on the product: verifica/bozza need ref (incentive id) and input (business profile + pr

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Status of an order by its token; when ready, the full report as structured JSON.
